notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Dear Chess Puzzlers,

We want to share some exciting news with you today!
Our Gambit Shifter Demo has undergone a significant update, including some features you have frequently requested.

Here's a quick rundown of the improvements we've introduced.

[u][h3]Undo[/h3][/u]
After receiving much feedback in recent months regarding the missing Undo feature, we've worked hard to include it in the updated demo! 
Now, you have the chance to retrace your steps and alter the course of events that led to an unpleasant outcome.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43768188/e5abc8a09513a9c0a9dbc7628053faed8c47826d.gif[/img]

[b][u][h3]UI Graphic Improvements[/h3][/u][/b]
We've undergone an overhaul of the UI, it wasn't as satisfying as we wanted. So we worked to make sure it reinforces the sense of pleasantness and reward for the players!

[b][u][h3]Music and Sound[/h3][/u][/b]
We have massively reworked the soundtrack, which now features 7 original tracks (3 of which are included in the demo). 
The sounds have also been improved to enhance the gaming experience!

[b][u][h3]Localization[/h3][/u][/b]
We have added full support for Chinese and Japanese languages, in addition to all other supported languages!


[b][h2]What comes next[/h2][/b]

[b][u][h3]Skip Level[/h3][/u][/b]
In the next update, we're implementing the ability to skip levels to prevent situations from becoming insurmountable obstacles. 
Our aim is for you to relax while tackling our puzzles, minimizing frustration.

[b][u][h3]Next Fest[/h3][/u][/b]
Exciting news! Gambit Shifter will be part of the upcoming Steam Next Fest! 
This presents a unique opportunity for players to try the demo and provide feedback.


[url=discord.gg/2Vh2cVpvk7][img]https://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steam/apps/2331060/extras/BannerDiscord_lineart.png?t=1706094678[/img][/url]

We greatly value your feedback, and we've carefully listened to your suggestions. 
Please don't hesitate to reach out with any thoughts or suggestions you may have.

Thanks for being a part of our chess puzzle adventure!

notes.title: Demo update!
notes.content:
Dear Chess Puzzlers,

We want to share some exciting news with you today. Our Gambit Shifter Demo has undergone a significant update, and we believe it's going to take your puzzle-solving experience to new heights.

Here's a quick rundown of the remarkable improvements we've introduced:

🖌️ [b]Enhanced Visuals:[/b]
While our game offers a minimalist experience, we're committed to ensuring that the chess world we've crafted is visually captivating. With this in mind, we've elevated the game's visuals, enhancing the aesthetics for a more visually pleasing adventure.


💥 [b]New Visual Effects:[/b]
We've added a lot of new visual effects to make your chess puzzling more dynamic and engaging. These effects are not only eye-catching but also designed to boost the satisfaction of flawlessly completing a level. Every move you make is now a visual treat.


🎮[b] Enhanced User Experience:[/b]
We value your feedback, and we've listened carefully to your suggestions. This update includes streamlined user interfaces, making navigation more intuitive. 
We've also fine-tuned the tutorial to ensure that players of all levels, whether beginners or seasoned chess enthusiasts, can easily grasp the game mechanics.

We are pushing forward the develop of the full version of Gambit Shifter, adding a lot of new mechanics to discover and master!

Your feedback is invaluable to us, so please don't hesitate to reach out with any thoughts or suggestions you might have. We're here to make your chess puzzling experience as enjoyable as possible.

Stay tuned for more updates, and as always, thanks for being a part of our chess puzzle adventure!
